scenes.notes: [S7 chorus (caps) + proxy objection shut down] Everyone up! Why up? You go out in a gas leak. Stairwell's full of gas. Go now. Thirty-seven neighbours replied, on my way. Everyone but me.
[S7 proximity: feet past my door, torches under the gap] Then feet went past my door, up the roof stairs. Nobody ran.
[S7 knock] Tess. It's Abel, from next door. Everyone is waiting for you.
[S7 the too-polite neighbour]
[S7 count deduction: 37 replied, 38 sets of feet] I didn't open. I'd counted thirty-eight sets of feet.

scenes.notes: [S8 broken lowercase + two unanswered name checks] its so quiet up here I typed, Dee? Mrs. Lind? Seen. Nobody answered.
[S8/B9 scariest image: one footstep above my bed, held] Then one footstep, right above my bed.

callouts.sub: No leak reported at that address

scenes.notes: [S9 lifeline: the real authority says no leak] I called the gas line. No leak reported at that address.

messages.text: The office types for a full minute.

scenes.notes: [S9 I call my own number] Then I called my own number. It rang. Up on the roof, faintly, my ringtone was playing.
[S9 the ringtone is on the roof]

messages.text: At 2:14 the office will call a gas leak and send everyone up to the roof.
I went. Now you have to.

notifications.title: Me · 2:31 AM
notifications.text: At 2:14 the office will call a gas leak and send everyone up to the roof. Don't go. Not even if they beg.

notifications.title: Me
notifications.text: Please. I'm begging you. Open up. It's just me.

scenes.notes: [S10 cliff: the beg, bookend lock screen] My phone lit up beside me. Please. I'm begging you. Open up. It's just me.
